title: Rollcall image list export
description: The input behind ROLLCALL_IMAGES_FILE: one entry per app, joined to a repository on its group/project path. Any platform can produce it (Citadel, OpenShift, Coolify, a hand-kept file). Extra fields are ignored, so a producer may add its own.

project.description: The repository path, such as group/project

image.description: The runtime image tag, such as php:8.4-apache
